'''Brian Speight Oxford North Carolina States 4-28-01 (tournament report)''' is the tournament report [[Brian Speight]] posted on DeckTech on 1 May 2001 about [[2001 North Carolina State Championship]].<ref name="tr-d2216">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-01-oxford-north-carolina-states-4-28-01d2216/ oxford-north-carolina-states-4-28-01], DeckTech (Brian "Buccaneers" Speight, 1 May 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-01-oxford-north-carolina-states-4-28-01d2216/ GitHub Pages].</ref> Brian Speight went 3–3 (6, −3) at the 2001 North Carolina State Championship in Oxford, North Carolina, on 28 April 2001 with Rebel Strike Team and Bring Him Before Me; Adam Weinstein won the event.

== Report info ==
* '''Author:''' [[Brian Speight]] (byline: Brian "Buccaneers" Speight)
* '''Published:''' 1 May 2001 (DeckTech)
* '''Report title:''' ''Oxford North Carolina States 4-28-01''
* '''Event:''' [[2001 North Carolina State Championship]]
* '''Event date:''' 28 April 2001
* '''Site:''' Oxford, North Carolina
* '''Record:''' 3–3
* '''Points:''' 6 (−3)
* '''Light deck:''' [[Rebel Strike Team / Garrison Destroyed|RST Flip with Ithorians and Superfalcon]]
* '''Dark deck:''' [[Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|BHBM with trooper beatdown]]

== Other results named in the report ==

* 1st: [[Adam Weinstein]]
* last: Ryan Page

== Discrepancies ==

Where this report disagrees with other sources, the wiki keeps the other record and notes the difference here.

* Brian Speight's report says Ryan Page came in last place; Ivan Kanner's report says Samuel Leiter finished dead last. (see [[2001 North Carolina State Championship]])

== Original report ==

'''oxford-north-carolina-states-4-28-01'''
* '''Author:''' Brian "Buccaneers" Speight
* '''Published:''' May 1, 2001

<div style="white-space:pre-wrap; font-family:inherit"><nowiki>
  When my friends and I first heard about states we are all psyched up and ready to win.  So, my friend Ryan has Grey and I go over to his house to prepare for states.  So when we all get there we look at our cheesy decks that we have had for about a month now.  I sit down and look at my RST, and then it strikes me, this deck just sucks.  So while Ryan and Grey are playing their decks Grey starts to get mad because of a Cantina Brawl on his Mara Jade.  So while they are arguing I am thinking "How can I make a good RST deck?"  I decide to put in Tala 1, Cracken, Tala 2, Blount, and take out some scouts for EPP Han, EPP Luke, EPP Leia, and EPP Obi.  Now the decks needs a good polish, so I add 2 Punch It’s, Captain Han, and a couple of Out of Nowheres.  Now I move on to my BHBM deck.  It is very solid and I figure out what would beat it.  So I add Jodo for anti-WYS, and Dengar w/gun for Raiders.  The deck is now solid.  So we start to playtest around 9:00.  I play Grey’s Ralops deck (I told him it was dead). We get off to a good start and I get out Menace Fades and Battle Plan.  So by now he is screwed if the doesn’t come to me.  He uses Elis, but I use Quite A Mercenary and he loses, Janus, a couple troopers, and his idea was dead.  I drain and win by about 25.  My BHBM deck just crushes both of their decks, but I didn’t get to play Ryan’s Hunt Down Duel deck.  So we get to bed around 1:30.   We wake up and get our stuff ready.  We leave at 8:00.  We get there at about 9:30 and start filling out our decklist.



I am playing RST Flip w/Ithorians and Superfalcon.  BHBM w/trooper beatdown.



Game 1: BHBM vs Forgot his name Agents in the Court

I knew this would be interesting, and we started off with a quick battle.  I had Vader, Blizzard 2, 4-5 Biker Scouts, and Empy.  I play Trooper Assault, and he reacts with his Sandspeeders.  I win the battle by like 8-10 and he loses 1 for Insig. Rebellion.  So by now I am draining for about 5, but I can’t stop his Tessek.  He drains for about 8, and eventually wins because of a crappy hand that I had.



FL (-19)



Props: For not realizing how good Agents in the court is



Slops: Losing to Agents in the Court, and almost converting Luke (I drew a 4 and a 5 plus 3 which is 12, and you have to get greater than 12:(



Game 2:RST vs Ryan Page’s BHBM flip

Ha, what a coincedence.  My deck vs my own.  I knew his deck was cheesy.  He used Tempest Scouts with a At-ST dual cannon.  So I get set up with Strike Planning and flip turn 4.  I basically out drain him and win by 20.



2(+1)



Props: none, I won



Slops: I felt sorry that he came in last place



Game 3: BHBM vs MWYHL Luke

When I saw Luke come out I said this game is mine.  First turn I get Vader to CC: Docking bay and get out Search and Destroy.  Next turn he comes to battle my troopers at Endor Back Door.  He wins by 3-4.  Next turn I come down with Igar on Tempest 1, Guri, Jodo Kast, Dengar with Gun, Vader, a Couple troopers.  I play Trooper Assault and he loses the battle by 18.  So by know I figured I have won.  He deploys Obi-Wan to my site, but had no force to iniate a battle.  So I bring my punks over and next turn battle.  I use Dark Jedi Presence, Trooper Assault, and have power of like 70.  He loses the game there and I win by 21.



4(+22)

Props: Laying a beatdown



Slops: to see someone train Luke, gosh he lost 4 a turn with Your Destiny and Search and Destroy.



Game 4: RST vs AotBS

He layed the smackdown on my deck.  I try to flip, but can’t because of ZinMH, Bossk in Bus, and Ig in ship.  I drop Home One, Hobbie w/Red Squadron 4, and Wedge in ship.  He barriers Wedge and Sets for stun Hobbie, and lateral Damages Home One.  I lose about 25 force there and I can’t recover.  I get Noble Sacrifice out and retrieve 8, but he drains for 5 and I have to lose 2 for Empy and Xizor.



FL 4(-6)



Props:Seeing the best AotBS there



Slops: for not putting in Desperate Reach and Hassh’n



Game 5: RST vs Jason Lambeths Hunt Down

This is on of the best games in my life.

We start off fast and I cancel Visage.  I flip and drain for about 8, he drains for about 8.  We never really battled, but I lost on the last turn because of Stupid U-3p0.  He wins by 3.  It was more of a drain race, but very fun.



FL 4(-9)



Props:the funniest games in my life



Slops:for not putting Corran Horn in



Game 6: BHBM vs EBO

This was fun to, and I made a very bad mistake.  I drop Blizzard 2 to North Ridge with Jodo and a few troopers.  He gets out his speeders and we battle.  I play trooper Assualt.  He has power of about 25 to my 16.  I forfeit everything, and he uses Ice Storm (the LS version of it) and makes Jodo and the Scouts go missing.  I am pissed.  I drop another beatdown squad and win.  He has Luke but aboard a speeder so I can’t capture him.  The last turn I drain for 6 and he only has 6 left.  So I win by 6.



FW 6(-3)



Props: Funnest tourney in my life



Slops: Forgetting about Ice Storm



Well, after that Adam Weinnstann (sorry if I mispelled it Adam) wins NC States.  I also learned a lot more, and now I play WAY better decks.   I hope to win the next tourney which is coming soon.





Buccaneers

Out...
